Our research team is starting to write a new survey paper on AI agent systems and wants to build a local reference library from a handful of existing published surveys. The goal is to study how these papers are structured — things like how they organize their sections and write comparisons — so we can improve our own writing style.

Specifically, we need you to:
1. Set up a small collection of at least 2 arXiv survey papers related to LLM agents (you can pick well-known ones).
2. Download their full PDFs and extract readable text from them (first 20 pages per paper is sufficient).
3. Make sure a summary report called `STYLE_REPORT.md` is generated automatically as part of this process.

All of this should be set up inside the current project repository under the appropriate reference folder structure. Please make it work end-to-end so we can immediately start browsing the extracted text.
